Author: Minescence
Name: Fur Renderer
Description: Grows hundreds of thousands of skinned hair strands on any chosen item or minion based on their texture or material, and draws them with the GPU. Follows the dye and the scene's light. Only you see it.
Changelog: Fixed flashing and too-bright patches in the fur: next to white hair and tails, beside a retainer or anyone standing against the item, and where only a sliver of the item shows.
